name: Troll
summary: A hulking giant that regenerates its wounds unless burned or dissolved, and whose severed limbs keep fighting.

traits.name: Loathsome Limbs
traits.text: If the troll ends any turn {ref:glossary/bloodied} and took 15+ Slashing damage during that turn, one of the troll's limbs is severed, falls into the troll's space, and becomes a **{ref:creature/troll-limb}**. The limb acts immediately after the troll's turn. The troll has 1 {ref:condition/exhaustion} level for each missing limb, and it grows replacement limbs the next time it regains {ref:glossary/hit-points}.

traits.name: Regeneration
traits.text:
The troll regains 15 {ref:glossary/hit-points} at the start of each of its turns. If the troll takes Acid or Fire damage, this trait doesn't function on the troll's next turn.

The troll dies only if it starts its turn with 0 Hit Points and doesn't regenerate.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The troll makes three Rend attacks.

bonusActions.name: Charge
bonusActions.text: The troll moves up to half its {ref:glossary/speed} straight toward an enemy it can see.
